blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present LucidLyra, a framework that makes generatively reconstructed 3D scenes directly queryable for semantics and instances in a feed-forward manner from video latents. While generative 3D reconstruction can synthesize virtual environments from a single image, downstream applications in robotics and physical AI require not only visual realism but also access to scene semantics and object identities. Existing 3D understanding approaches, however, require captured multi-view scenes, have limited generalization capabilities, or rely on expensive per-scene processing and optimization. To bridge this gap, our method distills complementary knowledge from a camera-controlled video diffusion model and frozen 2D vision foundation models into a unified model to jointly infer 3D Gaussians encoding geometry, appearance, open-vocabulary semantics, and class-agnostic instance cues. The resulting scenes support novel-view rendering, open-vocabulary segmentation, and object grouping without per-scene optimization, while training requires neither manual 3D annotations nor captured multi-view data. Our method outperforms baselines combining state-of-the-art 3DGS segmentation approaches with generative 3D scene reconstruction on curated synthetic and real-image-conditioned benchmarks, while preserving reconstruction quality. Furthermore, our latent formulation naturally extends to monocular video, reconstructing structured dynamic 3D scenes across time. By turning renderable but unstructured outputs into queryable 3D worlds, LucidLyra enables downstream applications including 3D scene editing, 3D asset mining, and robotic simulation.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍LucidLyra, 这个框架使基因重建的 三维场景可以直接查询语义学和实例, 虽然基因3D重建可以从单一图像中合成虚拟环境,但下游在机器人和物理AI中的应用不仅需要视觉现实主义,还需要获得场景语义和对象身份. 然而,现有的三维理解方法需要捕捉到多视图场景,具有有限的通俗化能力,或者依赖于昂贵的人均场景处理和优化. 为了弥补这一差距,我们的方法从相机控制的视频传播模型和被冻结的2D视觉基础模型中提炼出互补知识,并形成一个统一的模型,共同推断出3D高斯人编码几何,外观,开口的语义学,以及类不可知实例提示. 由此产生的场景支持小说-视图渲染,开放式-vocabulary分集,以及对象分组而不进行每个场景优化,而训练则既不需要手动3D说明,也不需要抓取多视图数据. 我们的方法超越了将最新技术的3DGS分解方法与基因三维场景重建相结合的基线,同时保持了重建质量。 此外,我们的潜在配方自然延伸至单相机视频,重建结构化的动态立体场景。 LucidLyra通过将可变而无结构的输出转化为可查询的3D世界,实现了下游应用,包括3D场景编辑,3D资产挖掘和机器人模拟.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent generative reconstruction methods can turn a single image into a renderable 3D environment. Building upon learned generative models, they can imagine content beyond the observed field of view and consolidate it into a scene that can be viewed from new perspectives [ 14 , 72 , 52 , 85 , 76 , 2 ] .
Generated 3D environments are promising for scalable content generation in interactive media, physical AI simulation, and industrial applications in engineering and manufacturing [ 16 ] .
However, existing generated scene representations primarily capture geometry and appearance, while lacking an explicit understanding of their content. Downstream applications in embodied AI and physical simulation cannot interact with an collection of colored primitives; they require structured scene elements with semantic roles and discrete instance boundaries to support collision reasoning, physical manipulation, and interactive scene editing.
blocks.zh:
最近的基因重建方法可以将单个图像转化为可渲染的立体环境. 在所学遗传模型的基础上,他们可以想象超出观测视野的内容,并将其整合为一个可以从新视角来看的场景[14,72,52,85,76,2].
生成的3D环境对于交互式媒体的可扩展内容生成,物理AI模拟,以及工程和制造中的工业应用[16]很有希望.
然而,现有的场景表现主要捕捉几何和外观,同时缺乏对其内容的明确理解. 体现的AI和物理模拟中的下游应用不能与彩色原始物的集合相互作用;它们需要结构化的场景元素,具有语义作用和离散实例边界,以支持碰撞推理,物理操纵,以及交互式场景编辑.

blocks.en:
A natural solution might seem to generate an appearance-only scene first and recover semantic and instance representations post-hoc.
However, this two-stage route breaks down in the single-view generative setting. Existing post-hoc methods either attach 2D foundation-model predictions to an existing reconstruction through per-scene optimization [ 67 , 105 , 87 , 100 ] , or jointly infer geometry and understanding from multiple captured views [ 117 , 26 , 88 ] .
The former requires expensive scene-specific foundation model preprocessing and optimization.
The latter relies on captured multi-view inputs and is constrained by the limited scale and domain diversity of multi-view training data.
Neither route directly yields a structured 3D scene that has been generated from a single image.
blocks.zh:
一个自然的解决办法可能似乎首先产生一个只显示的场景,并恢复浩克后的语义和实例表述.
然而,这个两阶段的路线在单视基因设定中崩溃. 现有的热后方法要么通过每个场景的优化将2D基建模型预测附在现有的重建上[67,105,87,100],要么从多个捕捉到的观点共同推断几何和理解[117,26,88].
前者需要昂贵的场景特定基础模型预处理和优化.
后者依赖所获取的多视图输入,并受到多视图培训数据规模和领域多样性有限的限制。
两条路由都没有直接产生一个结构化的由单一图像生成的3D场景.

blocks.en:
Scaling these capabilities is not merely a matter of attaching a feature head to a reconstruction model. Generated regions lack paired ground-truth supervision, so estimated geometry, semantics, and object boundaries can drift and disagree across views. Predictions from 2D vision models compound this, as their semantics and masks are not guaranteed to be view-consistent. The central challenge is to turn complementary but imperfect generative and perceptual signals
into a consistent 3D representation while balancing geometry, appearance, semantics, and instances without compromising generation quality.
An integrated model should let semantic priors and geometry reinforce each other, rather than tagging an isolated reconstruction with semantic or object information.
blocks.zh:
扩大这些能力不仅仅是把特征放在重建模式上的问题。 生成区域缺乏对地-真实性的监督,因此估计的几何、语义和物体边界可能会漂移,并产生不同意见。 2D视觉模型的预测使这种情况复杂化,因为其语义学和口罩不能保证其视线一致. 中心挑战是改变补充性但不完整的基因和认知信号
在平衡几何、外观、语义和不减损生成质量的情况下,形成一致的三维表示。
一个综合模型应该让语义前言和几何学相互加强,而不是用语义或对象信息标记孤立的重建.

blocks.en:
We introduce LucidLyra, a framework that unifies feed-forward generative 3D reconstruction and scene understanding in an explicit Gaussian representation ( Fig. 1 ).
Our central insight is that a video generator provides a unified foundation for structured 3D scene generation, serving both as the shared backbone and as the source of training data.
Building on Lyra’s latent-to-Gaussian formulation [ 2 ] , LucidLyra learns a 3D scene representation from camera-controlled video latents through multi-task distillation. Given a single input image, we denoise the corresponding video latents across camera trajectories, and process them through two parallel branches. The teacher branch decodes the latent into an RGB video and applies frozen vision-language, segmentation, and tracking foundation models to obtain semantic and instance supervision. The student branch incorporates vision cues of the input view into the video latents and directly maps the shared latent into a 3D Gaussian scene. We consolidate the teacher predictions across the generated views and distill them into persistent semantic and instance fields on the Gaussian primitives, jointly with geometry and appearance.
A single shared representation can therefore support novel-view rendering,
open-vocabulary segmentation, and object grouping.
As an initial exploration toward generative 4D scene
understanding, we also extend the formulation to monocular video inputs and predict
semantics- and instance-aware dynamic 3D scenes.
For this novel task, we introduce an evaluation protocol with benchmarks covering static scenes, real-image domain transfer, and dynamic scenes.

blocks.en:
On our static LucidLyra-SDG benchmark, LucidLyra improves semantic mIoU and
class-agnostic instance mTrackPR over the strongest comparable baseline by 31.7 31.7 and 9.8 9.8 percentage points,
while maintaining reconstruction fidelity, with a modest PSNR gain of 0.53 0.53 dB over Lyra.
More broadly, this formulation turns pretrained video generation into a
scalable source of supervision for structured 3D learning, opening a path from
renderable but unstructured outputs to queryable 3D worlds that downstream
systems can reason about and interact with. In summary, our contributions are: • We introduce a unified generative 3D model that produces an explicit
Gaussian scene representation with geometry, appearance, open-vocabulary semantic, and class-agnostic instance features from a single image in a feed-forward fashion. • We develop a multi-task distillation strategy that transfers
2D generative, semantic, and object-level knowledge through aligned generated
views into a consistent 3D representation. This enables task-specific training
without captured multi-view data or manual 3D annotations, and avoids
per-scene optimization at inference time. • We jointly evaluate reconstruction and understanding on static and dynamic scenes. LucidLyra consistently outperforms two-stage baselines across optimization-based, mask-lifting, and feed-forward 3DGS segmentation methods, while maintaining novel-view reconstruction fidelity on static scenes with a small reconstruction trade-off on dynamic scenes. We further demonstrate downstream applications including robotic simulation, 3D scene editing, and 3D asset mining.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
From observed reconstruction to generative scene construction. Neural radiance fields [ 58 ] and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) [ 28 ] fit per-scene representations, while feed-forward methods amortize reconstruction across scenes to predict 3D Gaussians for novel-view synthesis [ 6 , 110 ] or estimate dense depth and camera parameters [ 93 , 54 , 4 ] . Dynamic formulations underwent a similar evolution from per-sequence fitting [ 104 , 103 ] to feed-forward estimation [ 53 , 101 , 32 ] , yet all remain bounded by observed multi-view coverage.
Generative methods relax this constraint by synthesizing unobserved content. Early works distill diffusion priors into per-scene optimizations or iterative view inpaintings [ 64 , 19 ] . Multi-view generators synthesize dense video trajectories for downstream reconstruction [ 14 , 74 ] , with later extensions incorporating panoramic scaffolds, geometric alignment, or long-horizon expansion [ 92 , 94 , 18 , 79 , 54 , 89 ] . However, generation and 3D reconstruction remain decoupled into different stages.
blocks.zh:
从观察重建到基因场景建造. 神经辐射场[58]和3D高斯电镀(3DGS)[28]适合每个场景的表示,而饲料前导方法则分期分解重建,预测3D高斯用于新视觉合成[6,110]或估计密度深度和相机参数[93,54,4]. 动态配方也经历了类似的演变,从每序列配制[104,103]到饲料预估[53,101,32],但所有配方仍受观察到的多视图覆盖的约束。
基因方法通过合成不可见的内容来放松这种制约. 早期的作品将扩散前科蒸馏成每个场景的优化或迭代视图涂料[64,19]. 多景发电机为下游重建合成密集的视频轨迹[14,74],后期扩展包含全景脚手架,几何对齐,或长视距扩展[92,94,18,79,54,89]. 然而,发电和立体重建仍然处于不同的阶段。

blocks.en:
A closer line to our setting couples generation directly with feed-forward 3D prediction. Recent methods decode video latents into Gaussians [ 52 ] , embed Gaussian feature fields within video diffusion [ 76 ] , directly generate explicit 3D representations [ 85 , 77 ] , or align generative image, video, and 3D latent spaces [ 47 , 21 , 15 ] .
Lyra [ 2 ] self-distills a feed-forward Gaussian decoder from a camera-controlled video foundation model [ 72 , 59 ] , using synthetic multi-view video trajectories as both the latent input and the supervision target for static and dynamic 3D synthesis. We build upon Lyra’s scalable, latent-to-Gaussian formulation, extending its feed-forward output from raw geometry and appearance to joint language-grounded semantics and class-agnostic instances.
blocks.zh:
更接近我们设定的夫妇代 直接与饲料向前的3D预测。 最近的方法解码视频潜伏到高斯人 [52],将高斯人特征域嵌入视频传播 [76],直接生成明确的3D表示 [85,77],或者对齐基因图像,视频,以及3D潜伏空间 [47, 21, 15].
Lyra [2] 自行从相机控制的视频基建模型[72,59]中跳出一个向导的高斯解码器,将合成多视图视频轨迹作为静态和动态3D合成的潜伏输入和监督目标. 我们借鉴了Lyra的可伸缩、潜伏到古西语的配方,将它的饲料输出从原始几何学和外观扩展到基于语言的联合语义学和阶级不可知的例子。

blocks.en:
From per-scene optimization to amortized 3D scene understanding. Early works predict semantics and instances from point clouds [ 65 , 66 , 9 , 25 ] , while subsequent methods lift open-vocabulary 2D foundation features onto reconstructed geometry [ 63 , 23 , 86 ] or embed language fields into neural representations [ 113 , 36 , 81 , 29 ] .
For 3DGS, several approaches optimize per-Gaussian language fields, aggregate 2D foundation features, or lift multi-view masks into object-aware representations [ 45 , 100 , 116 , 67 , 87 , 31 , 7 , 105 , 98 , 78 , 99 ] .
Feed-forward methods amortize understanding across scenes, either by encoding pre-existing 3DGS reconstructions [ 50 ] or by jointly predicting geometry alongside semantic, panoptic, or instance structure from multi-view inputs [ 42 , 117 , 26 , 88 , 49 , 40 , 35 , 43 , 80 , 84 , 56 , 107 , 38 , 111 ] .
Generative understanding approaches synthesize observations for language-aware reconstruction, modular scene assembly, or driving-specific world models [ 55 , 22 , 106 , 11 ] . Yet, these formulations remain confined to domain-specific priors or assume multiple posed observations.
blocks.zh:
从每个场景优化到摊销3D场景理解. 早期的作品从点云[65,66,9,25]预测语义学和实例,而后来的方法将开放-vobulary 2D基础特征提升到重建的几何上[63,23,86]或嵌入语言领域到神经表达[113,36,81,29].
对3DGS来说,几种方法优化了每古西语域,集合2D基础特征,或者将多视图口罩提升到物体感知表达[45,100,116,67,87,31,7,105,98,78,99].
Feed-forward方法分期摊还了不同场景的理解,方法有的是通过编码先前存在的3DGS重建[50],有的则通过多视图输入法共同预测几何与语义结构,泛光结构或实例结构[42,117,26,88,49,40,35,43,80,84,56,107,38,111].
基因理解方法综合了语言意识重建,模块场景组装,或驱动特定世界模型的观测结果[55,22,106,11]. 然而,这些提法仍局限于特定领域的前科,或假定提出多种意见。

blocks.en:
Existing approaches follow two main paradigms: augmenting a scene-specific reconstruction or jointly inferring geometry and segmentation from multi-view inputs.
The former requires a pre-existing reconstruction, precluding single-view generation, while post-hoc lifting decouples semantics from geometry, leaving fusion vulnerable to cross-view inconsistencies. Crucially, both rely on an expensive preprocessing stage with a 2D vision foundation model.
Feed-forward approaches jointly predict geometry and segmentation, but train on captured multi-view datasets with narrow domain coverage limiting generalization.
LucidLyra instead unifies scene understanding with generative reconstruction. Conditioned on a single image, its amortized latent-to-Gaussian decoder jointly predicts geometry, appearance, language-aligned semantic features, and class-agnostic instance features in a single feed-forward pass, without prior 3D reconstructions, per-scene optimization, or post-hoc lifting. Distilling frozen foundation models on generated video eliminates the need for captured multi-view data or manual 3D annotations.
blocks.zh:
现有方法遵循两个主要范式:增加场景特异性的重建或从多景投入中共同推断几何和分化.
前者需要先进行重建,排除了单视生成,而后Hoc提升解离几何的语义,使得聚变易受到交叉视不一致的影响. 关键的是,两者都依赖于一个昂贵的预处理阶段,带有2D视觉基础模型.
Feed-forward方法联合预测几何和分区,但是在俘获的多景数据集上进行训练,范围狭窄,限制了一般化.
LucidLyra转而用基因重建来统一场景的理解. 以单一图像为条件,其摊还的潜对古斯士解码器联合预测了几何,外观,语言相适应的语义特征,以及单向消息传出的类不可知实例特征,没有之前的3D重建,每个场景优化,或者后升空. 在生成的视频上稀释冷冻的基底模型,消除了获取多视图数据或手动3D说明的需要.

blocks.en: 3 Semantic- and Instance-Aware Generative 3D Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3 语义学和实例学

blocks.en: Given an input image 𝐈 0 \mathbf{I}_{0} , LucidLyra generates a queryable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 28 ] scene representation whose primitives jointly encode geometry, appearance, language-aligned semantics, and class-agnostic instance identity. Rather than supervising reconstruction alone as in Lyra [ 2 ] , we use the multi-view outputs of a camera-controlled video generator to construct aligned 2D semantic and instance targets using frozen vision foundation models and distill them into an explicit 3D representation via an amortized feed-forward decoder ( Fig. 2 ).

blocks.en:
To equip Gaussians with semantic and instance awareness, we introduce additional conditioning using vision features of the input image and dedicated output heads. First, we supplement the video model latents 𝐙 \mathbf{Z} with dense input image features 𝐅 0 \mathbf{F}_{0} extracted with C-RADIOv3 [ 69 , 17 , 70 ] .
We align 𝐅 0 \mathbf{F}_{0} with 𝐙 \mathbf{Z} through a learned linear projection to the latent feature dimension. Spatial interpolation matches 𝐅 0 \mathbf{F}_{0} to the latent token grid, and broadcasting replicates it across trajectories and latent time. Each latent-time slice is then modulated by a learned scalar weight shared across channels and a learned global gate before being added to the video and ray tokens.
Next, the 3DGS decoder’s shared trunk fuses the multi-view tokens into features 𝐇 = { 𝐡 i } i = 1 N \mathbf{H}=\{\mathbf{h}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} , where each feature corresponds to a source ray on the multi-view video latent grid.
Two parallel heads map these shared features to complementary Gaussian attributes:
the reconstruction head D rec D_{\mathrm{rec}} predicts geometry and appearance parameters g i g_{i} ,
while the understanding head D seg D_{\mathrm{seg}} jointly predicts a semantic descriptor 𝐟 i sem ∈ ℝ 128 \mathbf{f}_{i}^{\mathrm{sem}}\in\mathbb{R}^{128} ,
an object-level instance embedding 𝐞 i inst ∈ ℝ 12 \mathbf{e}_{i}^{\mathrm{inst}}\in\mathbb{R}^{12} ,
and a part-level embedding 𝐞 i part ∈ ℝ 4 \mathbf{e}_{i}^{\mathrm{part}}\in\mathbb{R}^{4} : 𝒢 ~ = D 3 ​ D ​ G ​ S ( 𝐙 , 𝐄 , 𝐅 0 ) = { g ~ i } i = 1 N , g ~ i = [ D rec ( 𝐡 i ) ∥ D seg ( 𝐡 i ) ] . \widetilde{\mathcal{G}}=D_{\mathrm{3DGS}}(\mathbf{Z},\mathbf{E},\mathbf{F}_{0})=\{\tilde{g}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N},\qquad\tilde{g}_{i}=[D_{\mathrm{rec}}(\mathbf{h}_{i})\parallel D_{\mathrm{seg}}(\mathbf{h}_{i})]. (2) The shared 3DGS decoder trunk and each task-specific head consist of seven Mamba-2 [ 10 ] layers followed by one Transformer [ 91 ] layer.
Operating synchronously on the shared token grid attaches understanding fields directly to the co-located Gaussian g i g_{i} , bypassing post-hoc 2D-to-3D association.
For camera 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} , a differentiable renderer ℛ ⁡ ( 𝒢 ~ , 𝒞 k ) \mathcal{R}(\widetilde{\mathcal{G}},\mathcal{C}_{k}) outputs rendered RGB 𝐈 ^ k \hat{\mathbf{I}}_{k} , semantic maps 𝐅 ^ k sem \hat{\mathbf{F}}_{k}^{\mathrm{sem}} , and instance maps 𝐅 ^ k inst \hat{\mathbf{F}}_{k}^{\mathrm{inst}} via volumetric α \alpha -blending, and depth 𝐃 ^ k \hat{\mathbf{D}}_{k} by accumulating primitive center depths.

blocks.en: We supervise the understanding fields using decoded video frames 𝐈 k \mathbf{I}_{k} and frozen 2D vision foundation models—class-agnostic segmentation, video tracking, and vision-language foundation models—generalizing RGB self-distillation to multi-task 2D feature distillation without 3D labels. To resolve cross-view feature jitter and mask inconsistency across imagined views, we first establish cross-view object tracks to associate observations and pool coherent semantic targets.

blocks.en: Aligned instance targets. To associate objects across trajectories, we run SAM’s automatic mask generator on the shared first frame 𝐈 0 \mathbf{I}_{0} , filter redundancies by coverage, and use the surviving masks to seed independent SAM2 propagations along each trajectory [ 34 , 71 ] . The resulting class-agnostic instance tracklets Y k inst Y_{k}^{\mathrm{inst}} preserve trajectory visibility while linking observations from the same initial object. Regions disoccluded late in a trajectory lacking a first-frame seed are excluded from instance supervision.

Track-consistent semantic targets. The instance tracklets also let us aggregate semantic evidence across views.
We use RADSeg [ 1 ] to extract dense features aligned with the
SigLIP2 [ 90 ] image–text space for every decoded frame 𝐈 k \mathbf{I}_{k} .
Storing its native 1 152 1\,152 -dimensional descriptor on every Gaussian is computationally prohibitive, therefore we compress this space with a projection network P VL : ℝ 1152 → ℝ 128 P_{\mathrm{VL}}:\mathbb{R}^{1152}\!\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{128} for both image and text embeddings.
The projector is trained over frozen SigLIP2 image and text embeddings, using the vanilla SigLIP training objective [ 109 ] on the LAION-2B [ 75 ] dataset and remains frozen afterwards.
Within each camera trajectory, we pool projected features over all pixels and frames
belonging to each SAM track and assign the resulting centroid to every track
pixel. This yields semantic targets 𝐘 k sem \mathbf{Y}_{k}^{\mathrm{sem}} , where track pooling suppresses view-dependent feature jitter.

Initialized from the static model, the dynamic decoder trains with the same multi-task losses on τ \tau -synchronized views.
Dynamic scenes can only be supervised at the exact queried time, due to the changing scene.
Following Bahmani et al. [2] , we create six additional trajectories by processing the time-reversed input video and flipping it back. Each target frame is then paired with a same-time observation from a different viewpoint increasing multi-view supervision.
Since each query time yields an independently decoded Gaussian state, we implement temporal instance tracking via an online prototype codebook inspired by IGGT4D [ 118 ] .
At each query time, we represent each cluster by its normalized mean object
embedding and greedily match cluster prototypes to codebook entries one-to-one
above a cosine-similarity threshold. Matched clusters inherit persistent IDs
and update the stored prototypes through averaging weighted by Gaussian count,
while unmatched clusters initialize new IDs.

blocks.en:
We evaluate LucidLyra’s joint generative 3D reconstruction and scene understanding on synthetic and real-image-conditioned scenes, followed by an analysis of its key components. Dynamic experiments, additional quantitative and qualitative results, downstream applications,
and implementation details are provided in the appendix.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Datasets. We augment Lyra-SDG [ 2 ] with semantic and instance teacher targets for training ( Section 3.3 ) and annotations for evaluation. Lyra-SDG uses GEN3C [ 72 ] to expand images and videos generated from diverse text prompts into multiple camera trajectories per scene. Its 59 031 59\,031 static and 7 378 7\,378 dynamic scenes contain RGB videos, camera poses, depth maps, and video latents. We preprocess teacher targets for all 53 53 million frames.
A single image admits multiple plausible 3D completions. We evaluate agreement with fixed generated trajectories and their annotations.
Our three curated 25 25 -scene benchmarks use propagated reference annotations with human review and refinement: LucidLyra-SDG and LucidLyra-SDG Dynamic cover static and dynamic generated scenes, while LucidLyra-ADE20K uses real ADE20K validation images [ 114 ] to condition generated completions. All data and benchmarks will be released.

数据集. 我们增加了Lyra-SDG[2],增加了培训的语义和实例教师目标(第3.3节)和评价说明。 Lyra-SDG使用GEN3C[72]来扩展由不同文本提示生成的图像和视频,形成每个场景的多个相机轨迹. 它的59 031 59\ 031 静态和7 378 7\ 378 动态场景包含 RGB 视频,相机姿势,深度地图,以及视频潜伏. 我们为所有5亿3千3百万帧的老师 准备目标
单一的图像承认了多种可信的3D完成. 我们评价与固定生成的轨迹的协议及其说明。
我们的三条编订的25-25-场景基准使用经过人文审查和完善的传播参考说明: 路西德莱拉-SDG和路西德莱拉-SDG 动态封面静态和动态生成的场景,而LucidLyra-ADE20K则使用真实的ADE20K验证图像[114]作为条件生成完成. 所有数据和基准都将公布。

blocks.en: For qualitative results, we generate input images with GPT Image or FLUX [ 62 , 3 ] . For dynamic examples, we extend these to videos using Cosmos 3 [ 61 ] . We find that our method is agnostic to the choice of image-generation model.

blocks.en:
Evaluation. Following Lyra [ 2 ] , we report PSNR and LPIPS [ 112 ] for reconstruction.
Following Li et al. [45] , Xiong et al. [100] , Li et al. [50] , Li et al. [42] , we evaluate semantic segmentation using mIoU and mAcc over ADE20K classes present in each reference scene.
Building on IGGT and video instance segmentation [ 42 , 102 ] , we evaluate cross-view instance consistency using the mean track precision–recall product (mTrackPR) and TrackPR 25 at IoU 0.25 0.25 within ground-truth thing regions ( Section A.3 ).
blocks.zh:
评价。 跟着Lyra[2],我们报告PSNR和LPIPS[112]重建.
追赠李等人. [45],Xiong等人[100],李等人著. [50],李等人著. [42],我们使用mIoU和mAcc来评价每个参考场景中存在的ADE20K类上的语义分解.
根据IGGT和视频实例分解[42,102],我们利用IoU 0.25 0.25的轨道精度-召回产品(mTrackPR)和TrackPR 25在地面真相区域(A.3节),评价交叉视图实例的一致性。

blocks.en:
Baselines. We benchmark against existing 3D understanding methods combined with Lyra’s generative pipeline. Per-scene optimization : LangSplatV2, SFS, and Unified-Lift [ 45 , 100 , 116 ] fit feature fields on frozen Lyra Gaussians. Feed-forward : Chorus [ 50 ] processes frozen Lyra Gaussians, while IGGT [ 42 ] reconstructs geometry and instances directly from generated RGB videos. References : Reconstruction-only Lyra, alongside a teacher-lifting reference that directly assigns teacher features and instance IDs to frozen Lyra ray-aligned-Gaussians.
The latter contextualizes the quality of our segmentation training signals.

基线。 我们以现有的三维理解方法为基准, per-scene 优化: LangSplateV2, SFS, and United-Lift [45,100,116] 适合在冰冻的Lyra Gaussians上设置特征场. Feed-forward:Chorus [50] 处理冷冻Lyra Gaussians,而IGGT [42] 直接从生成的RGB视频中重建几何和实例. 参考文献:只重建的Lyra,与直接为冷冻的Lyra Ray-acent-Gausians指定教师特征和实例身份的教师升学参考文献同时.
后者结合了我们分解训练信号的质量。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented LucidLyra, which turns generated scenes into queryable 3D worlds by distilling generative and perceptual knowledge into a feed-forward Gaussian decoder.
A camera-controlled video model supplies both latent representations and training data, enabling joint reconstruction and understanding without captured multi-view data, manual 3D annotations, or per-scene optimization.
Experiments demonstrate improved semantic and instance understanding over the compared two-stage baselines while preserving Lyra’s reconstruction quality.
Furthermore, we demonstrate initial results on dynamic scenes and applications in 3D scene editing, 3D asset mining, and physical-AI simulation.
Future work could scale our approach by accelerated video generation [ 48 ] with larger-scale joint training for generation and scene understanding [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了LucidLyra, 它将生成的场景转化为可查询的3D世界, 通过衍射基因和感知知识 变成一个向导的高斯解码器。
相机控制的视频模型既提供潜在的表示,也提供培训数据,从而能够在没有捕获多视图数据、手动3D说明或每个场景优化的情况下进行联合重建和理解。
实验表明,在保持Lyra重建质量的同时,对比较的两阶段基线的语义和实例理解有所提高。
此外,我们在3D场景编辑、3D资产挖掘和物理-AI模拟中展示了动态场景和应用的初步结果。
今后的工作可以扩大我们的方法,加快视频生成[48],同时为生成和场景理解提供规模更大的联合培训[13]。

blocks.en:
Inference. We use batch size one and all six input trajectories.
At inference, we prune the lowest-opacity 80 80 % of Gaussians.
LucidLyra+ uses the same checkpoint and retained Gaussians, changing only semantic readout and the resulting instance grouping.
We ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalize Gaussian features and 128 128 -D text embeddings obtained by
projecting the SigLIP2 features from 1 152 1\,152 dimensions.
The learned instance embeddings are class-agnostic, but inference clusters them within predicted semantic classes.
For each class, we select the ⌈ 0.5 ​ N ⌉ \lceil$0.5$N\rceil highest-opacity Gaussians,
and average each normalized object embedding with k = 20 k=$20$ .
For all datasets, object clustering uses Euclidean HDBSCAN [ 5 ] with minimum cluster size 1 000 1\,000 , minimum samples 5 5 , ϵ = 0.06 \epsilon=$0.06$ , leaf selection, and a single cluster allowed.
Unassigned Gaussians are assigned to the nearest neighbor.

blocks.en: Baseline implementations. LangSplatV2 [ 45 ] , SFS [ 100 ] , Unified-Lift [ 116 ] , and Chorus [ 50 ] use a frozen Lyra [ 2 ] reconstruction. Our lifted-teacher reference changes only the feature fields, assigning our compressed SigLIP2 semantic features and deterministic 12 12 -D Hamming codes to RGB-derived SAM tracks via the ray-to-gaussian alignment. LangSplatV2 [ 45 ] independently optimizes three language levels for 10 000 10\,000 steps using a 64 64 -entry VQ codebook. SFS [ 100 ] lifts SAM ViT-H/OpenCLIP ViT-B/16 [ 8 ] features with Tikhonov coefficient 1.2 1.2 and temperature 100 100 . Unified-Lift [ 116 ] trains a 16 16 -D object field and 256 256 -entry codebook for 30 000 30\,000 steps with Adam [ 33 ] learning rates 2.5 × 10 − 3 2.5\text{\times}{10}^{-3} and 5 × 10 − 4 5\text{\times}{10}^{-4} ; and Chorus [ 50 ] uses its released language–DINO model. IGGT [ 42 ] reconstructs geometry from 11 11 calibrated 518 × 280 $518${\times}$280$ views and applies k = 20 k{=}$20$ feature smoothing followed by HDBSCAN ( ϵ = 0.01 , minPts = 100 , MCS = 500 ) (\epsilon{=}$0.01$,\ \mathrm{minPts}{=}$100$,\ \mathrm{MCS}{=}$500$) . Using more input views results in OOM errors and significantly increased inference time due to the HDBSCAN clustering while not improving the instance segmentation metrics. IGGT4D [ 118 ] streams all views through its fixed ViT-G/ 8 8 -D model in rewrite mode, using 0.90 0.90 / 0.85 0.85 match/grow thresholds and LSeg [ 39 ] semantics.

blocks.en: Open-vocabulary semantics. LangSplatV2 [ 45 ] and SFS [ 100 ] recover broad semantic structure but exhibit class confusion and label leakage across object boundaries, with LangSplatV2 additionally showing flickering artifacts as the viewpoint changes. The feed-forward baselines Chorus [ 50 ] and IGGT [ 42 ] exhibit incomplete category coverage and noisy boundaries, respectively. We hypothesize that their reduced performance partly reflects a domain shift from real-world and synthetic 3D training data to our generatively reconstructed scenes. LucidLyra preserves coherent semantic regions across viewpoints, approaching the lifted-teacher reference while correcting some of its assignment errors. LucidLyra+ further refines semantic assignments without changing geometry or appearance.
blocks.zh: 开放式省语义学. LangSplateV2 [45] 和 SFS [100] 恢复广义的语义结构,但表现出类混淆和标签跨对象边界的渗漏,随着视角的变化,LangSplateV2还额外展示了闪烁的文物. 饲料向导基线Chorus [50] 和IGGT [42] 分别显示出不完全的类别覆盖和吵闹的界限. 我们假设,它们的降低性能部分反映了域位从现实世界和合成3D训练数据转移到我们基因重建的场景。 LucidLyra保留了各种观点一致的语义区域,在纠正其一些任务错误的同时,接近了解职教师的参考。 LucidLyra+在不改变几何或外观的情况下进一步完善语义任务.

blocks.en: Instance segmentation. Unified-Lift [ 116 ] produces coherent instance regions but exhibits local label fragmentation and bleeding across object boundaries. IGGT shows blurred instance boundaries and a tendency to over-segment individual objects. Its reconstruction appears sensitive to cross-view inconsistencies in the generated videos, producing duplicated fine-scale structures that further blur segmentation predictions. Our methods preserve more coherent object-level partitions across viewpoints, while the lifted-teacher reference remains competitive. Since instance clustering is conditioned on predicted semantic classes, LucidLyra+ can modify instance partitions without changing the learned instance embeddings.

LucidLyra infers two levels of instance representations that we aim to analyze qualitatively in Fig. 10 .
The main object-level instance features group scene
entities, while additional part-level features expose finer regions within the recovered objects.
The qualitative results reveal a consistent feature hierarchy across all examples: object-level instance features remain similar over the spatial extent of an object, enabling clustering to recover a single instance mask, whereas part-level features preserve finer variations that distinguish individual object components. Because these representations form continuous feature fields, occasional grouping errors may still occur. While open-vocabulary querying and object-level instance segmentation provide the foundation for interacting with our generated scenes, part-level features offer a lightweight extension that enables finer-grained control over individual object components.

质量结果揭示了所有实例的一致特征等级:在物体的空间范围上,物体级实例特征仍然相似,使集群能够恢复单个实例掩码,而部分级特征则保留了更细细的变异,区分单个物体组件. 由于这些表示构成连续的特征字段,偶尔的分组错误可能仍然存在. 虽然开放的vocabulary查询和对象级实例分割为与我们生成的场景进行互动提供了基础,但部分级特征提供了一个轻量级扩展,使得能够更细度地控制单个对象组件.

blocks.en: Appendix D Downstream Applications
blocks.zh: 附录D 应用程序

blocks.en: LucidLyra generates structured, queryable scenes that support diverse downstream applications. In the following section, we demonstrate this capability through examples of robotic simulation, 3D scene editing, and 3D asset mining. See our project website for video demos.
blocks.zh: LucidLyra生成结构化,可查询的场景,支持不同的下游应用. 在下面的一节中,我们通过机器人模拟,3D场景编辑和3D资产挖掘等例子来展示这种能力. 请参看我们的项目网站 视频演示。

blocks.en: D.1 Robot Simulation
blocks.zh: D.1 机器人模拟

blocks.en:
We extract a mesh from the LucidLyra depth maps and camera parameters by computing a signed distance field on a hierarchy of sparse grids. We use the generated scene, extracted mesh and the semantic labels to set up a simulation in NVIDIA IsaacSim [ 60 ] . For navigation, the semantic labels partition the scene into free space and obstacles, over which we build an occupancy grid and plan a route to a semantically specified goal using a clearance-weighted Dijkstra search. A robot (Unitree G1 humanoid) then follows this route with a pure-pursuit controller while a learned rough-terrain locomotion policy drives its joints under full rigid-body physics.
The humanoid also carries a box rigidly attached near its torso to demonstrate loco-manipulation. For manipulation, the LucidLyra semantic labeling localizes a kitchen counter and sink in a separate reconstruction, from which we derive a mount pose and reach-constrained pick-and-place targets for a stationary Franka robotic arm. The arm is simulated with full articulated-body dynamics and a friction-based parallel-jaw grasp under differential inverse-kinematics control, picks a small synthetic object (a sphere) from the sink and places it on the counter. The extracted mesh serves as the collision proxy during simulation, while the original Gaussian-splat reconstruction [ 28 ] is rendered for visual fidelity. Figure 11 visualizes the simulation examples.

我们从LucidLyra的深度图和相机参数中提取一个网格, 通过计算一个在狭小的网格上签名的距离域。 我们使用生成的场景,提取网格和语义标签,在NVIDIA IsaacSim [60] 中设置模拟. 对于导航,语义标签将场景分割为自由空间和障碍物,我们为此构建一个占用网格,并计划一条通向精准指定目标的道路,使用清关加权的Dijkstra搜索. 机器人(Unitree G1 humanoid)然后使用纯纯净的服饰控制器遵循这条路线,而学习的粗糙的地铁运动政策则在全刚体物理下驱动其关节.
人体还携带一个刚性附着在躯干附近的盒子,以显示机能操纵. 为了操纵,LucidLyra语义标签将厨房柜台本地化,在单独的重建中沉入水中,我们从中得出一个挂载的姿势,以及固定的Franka机器人臂的可达限制的选手和位置目标. 臂部以完全的拼接体动力学和摩擦基平行抓取在偏差反相控下,从水槽中选择一个小合成物体(一个球体)并将其放置在柜台上. 提取的网格在模拟时充当碰撞的代理,而最初的高斯-浮雕重建[28]是为视觉忠贞而提供. 图11可视化模拟实例.

blocks.en: D.2 3D Scene Editing
blocks.zh: D.2 3D 场景编辑

blocks.en: We implement a simple browser-based editor. The user can select objects through text queries or clicks. Text selection intersects the predicted semantic class with an instance ID, thereby separating objects of the same category, while click selection retrieves the semantic–instance pair of the Gaussian center nearest the camera ray. Users can further refine the selection using separate similarity thresholds for Gaussian semantic and instance features relative to prototypes computed from the initial support.
blocks.zh: 我们实施一个简单的基于浏览器的编辑器. 用户可以通过文本查询或点击选择对象. 文本选择将预测的语义类与实例 ID 相交,从而分离同类对象,同时单击选择检索距离相机射线最近的高斯中心语义 - 内置对. 用户可以使用与初始支持计算的原型相比的高斯语语义和实例特征的单独相似性阈值来进一步完善选择.

blocks.en:
Translation, rotation, scaling, duplication, and deletion operate directly on the selected Gaussian parameters. Transformations are applied around the selection centroid and update positions, anisotropic scales, and orientation quaternions, while color, opacity, and learned features remain attached to each primitive. Duplication appends a transformed copy, whereas deletion removes the selected primitives.
Moving or deleting an object can expose unobserved regions. After the user commits all edits, OmniPaint [ 108 ] inpaints the original object support, and a subsequent LucidLyra forward pass reconstructs a clean background scene. We retain only reconstructed Gaussians near the edit whose projections fall within the exposed source support, excluding the transformed object’s footprint. Opacity tapering converts these Gaussians into a smoothly blended local background patch. Figure 12 visualizes our GUI as well as editing examples.

blocks.en: Dynamic representations

blocks.en:
Dynamic semantic and instance representations have likewise focused on captured
video, spanning per-sequence optimization and feed-forward reconstruction.
4D LangSplat [ 46 ] fits language features to deformable 4D
Gaussians, whereas TRASE [ 51 ] learns an instance field from
per-frame masks. Related methods distill foundation-model features or temporal
cues into scene-specific dynamic representations [ 37 , 12 , 115 , 24 , 20 , 96 , 27 ] .
Feed-forward approaches amortize language-aligned dynamic reconstruction [ 97 , 68 ] , while IGGT4D [ 118 ] jointly predicts streaming geometry and persistent instances.
